metadata.industry: Test - zone settings at boundary/low values (complements e01 max)
metadata.notes: L6 edge case. e01 drives every setting to its MAX value; this drives a representative set to LOW / opposite-of-default values (ssl=full not strict, min_tls=1.0, security=essentially_off, brotli/0rtt/tls_1_3/http3/rocket_loader off, browser_cache_ttl=30, challenge_ttl=300, cache_level=basic). Catches value-coercion / default-substitution bugs that a max-only test would miss (e.g. a setting that silently snaps to its default instead of carrying the source value). Reuses the validated independent settings assertions; no new hook code.
